No fees or shipping cost to participate, but the credit cannot be converted to cash.

steps: Answer the condition questions on samsung.com to get an instant trade-in value
Apply the credit to a qualifying Samsung purchase at checkout
Ship your old device to Samsung within 15 days of purchase
Samsung inspects the device; matching condition keeps the full credit
timing: Instant credit at purchase; device must be received within 15 days; inspection adjustments after receipt.
who_pays: Samsung - the payout comes directly from Samsung as trade-in credit on samsung.com, not cash from a third party.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the device you are trading in. The credit only works with a qualifying Samsung purchase, so you also need to be buying a new Samsung device.
work_available: Yes - the program was live on samsung.com as of 2026-09-23. It accepts eligible phones and devices, but value varies by model, condition, and demand, and some items get a $0 offer.
what_gets_accepted: Your device must power on and match the condition you described in the quote tool. If Samsung's inspection finds a mismatch, the credit is reduced or charged back; unaccepted devices are worth $0.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees and free return shipping. Your unpaid time is answering the condition questions (about 15-30 minutes), packing, and waiting through the 15-day send window and inspection.
when_cash_arrives: This is NOT cash - the value arrives as instant Samsung purchase credit at checkout, usable only on a qualifying Samsung purchase. It cannot be converted to cash.
